method: Each of six actual files individually inspected using view_image after reading exact production prompt. Five equal-weight editorial dimensions 0–100; overall >=85 and every critical dimension >=75. Cinematic still review, not orthographic anatomy, motion, optical simulation, game balance or canon-promotion certification.

images.name: Kethrane
observations: Mature weathered face, shaved hair and practical lamellar silhouette distinguish a grounded warrior rather than a glamour pose.
Both hands visibly hold the long grip, blade remains continuous, and wide foot placement is credible on the icy narrow bridge.
Opponent, thaw channel, timber structure and cold/warm lighting establish a specific duel geography.
defectsOrLimits: The hands are close together rather than widely separated, but their grip topology is coherent.
Her defensible claim and non-evil rivalry remain narrative assertions, not conclusions drawn from the image.

images.name: The Verdigris Monarch
observations: Hollow trunk, mineral-root body and broad stone-leaf canopy establish a nonfacial plant organism distinct from humanoid tree guardians.
An elevated root and falling soil reveal a sinkhole and show the creature changing the traversable environment.
Terraces, laboratory domes, two explorers and warm green light provide scale, civilization history and luminous wonder.
defectsOrLimits: The canopy is slightly cropped at the top.
Roots merge into living terrain; exact four-leg topology is not fully countable in this cinematic image and should not be labeled rig-verified.

images.name: Khaross
observations: Repeated short articulated legs, elongated body and blunt rasping mouth create credible arthropod threat.
Gold coloration belongs to the biological plate sequence rather than decorative jewelry; surface wear and dark belly prevent a toy finish.
The emerging mineral seam and surveyor connect feeding behavior to the botanical crater.
defectsOrLimits: Tail continues outside frame, appropriate to the long-body close composition.
Antenna forks and the exact stolen-vein mechanism are not clearly resolved. The visible mineral exposure supports feeding association but not the entire written causal explanation.

images.name: The Prism Warden
observations: Single tall prism, two horizontal vanes and faceless mineral supports are clearly recognizable.
The clear crystal and dark joint materials remain distinct; the severe storm court maintains a coherent visual relation to Avarra.
One incoming white beam and outgoing spectral paths communicate an optical encounter concept.
defectsOrLimits: Three support feet are clearly visible; a fourth may be occluded. The present silhouette reads close to a tripod, so a later reference sheet must settle the four-leg architecture.
Outgoing rainbow bands are more conspicuous and diagrammatic than the more restrained effects elsewhere. They remain legible but this should be the upper bound on rainbow intensity for the series.
Literal optical ray consistency and exact refraction are not validated by a generated still; present this as fictional optical key art rather than a physics demonstration.

images.name: Draeven
observations: Adult dark-bearded face, salt sash, coat and chain handling make an individual naval antagonist.
The tensioned chain connects visibly to the capstan, while the second grapnel hangs in a clear separate silhouette. Grip and grounded stance are coherent.
Ship keel, gangways, boats and boarding party make the arsenal feel inhabited and contested.
defectsOrLimits: Only one exposed grapnel head is clearly visible; the other chain endpoint is occluded around the capstan. This is plausible staging, not proof of the complete chain inventory.
The low grapnel is poised rather than visibly sweeping in motion; the still depicts preparation.

images.name: The Keelbreaker
observations: Unequal claws have different jobs: the large claw impacts the lifted hull while the smaller blocks the ladder beside the foreground escape viewpoint.
Cracked timber, streaming water, waves and wet shell deliver physical force and consequences.
Tiny protected eyes and broad heavy body retain natural crustacean identity without mascot expression.
defectsOrLimits: Some walking legs disappear in water or behind the body. Exact six-leg completeness is not independently countable.
The image shows the hull being punctured or crushed as well as lifted; the encounter description should permit that visible physical consequence.

ensembleNote: The faceless botanical organism and golden biological parasite successfully extend luminous adult fantasy. The Prism Warden is the lowest-scoring acceptance in this batch because its spectrum effects are comparatively diagrammatic and its support-leg count is visually ambiguous; neither is an observed extra-limb or broken-geometry hard failure.
